title: BANGLABOOK: A Large-scale Bangla Dataset for Sentiment Analysis from Book Reviews
findings: The analysis of popular book genres revealed that reviews for Islamic books were overwhelmingly positive. For 'Islamic Ideals and Doctrines', sentiment was 89.47% positive, and for 'Islamic Books: Self-Development', it was 95.81% positive. The authors suggest this is because these books provide guidance and spiritual fulfillment to readers.
